audit_member_text: [L118-L120,L229-L246,L303-L327] (MED/platform-configuration) MS_WIN64 is detected only inside the MSVC branch, so a 64-bit GNU Windows build falls through to four-byte pointer, size_t and HKEY definitions.

adversarial.rationale: The wrong four-byte configuration is real when this distributed header is reused for GNU Windows x64 without an externally supplied MS_WIN64: _WIN64 is translated only within the _MSC_VER block, and the GNU branch supplies no equivalent. Scope this to such extension/core builds, not the already compiled bundled Python executable; externally defining MS_WIN64 selects the correct eight-byte branch.
